title: Repair F4: make the clean heal byte-faithful (create-contract-gate registered at an 8-space block with a 4-space anchor)
host_restart_required: Yes — no module hot reload in this harness: the live session keeps the pre-repair semantics until dsh restarts. Claims are proven by direct module import, by the guard CLI, and by the isolated mounted boot (registration only).

f4.root_cause: mpd-delta create-contract-gate was registered with an 8-space block and a 4-space anchor, so the applier inserted at the anchor's indent and a healed quality-gates.js placed the create-time gate OUTSIDE if (WRITE_KINDS.includes(kind)) — silent, because the module still imported and still worked
f4.fix_structural: the region now wraps the whole if (WRITE_KINDS.includes(kind)) block, making it self-anchoring (block indent 4 == anchor indent 4) so an insert reproduces the canonical position exactly
f4.fix_class_guard: effectiveInsertionIndent() corrects a shallower anchor placement to the block's canonical indent and reports it via result.corrected / CLI '(indent corrected: …)'; canonicalIndent() is exported
f4.also: the registry now records anchorMarker (the first eligible line after a region) and resolves insertion by context rather than a blind occurrence index, so a repeated structural anchor is addressed deterministically; every anchor was regenerated to live outside all region spans

gates.command: the clean-heal byte-fidelity assertion: strip every region, --write, then readFileSync(healed) === readFileSync(canonical)
gates.evidence: healed === canonical byte-for-byte; gate inside the WRITE_KINDS block; anchor indent == block indent — f4/byte-fidelity.log and the permanent self-fix test 'F4: stripping every region and healing reproduces the canonical file byte-for-byte'
